zh-CN.title: 敦煌
zh-CN.subtitle: 丝绸之路上的宗教与文本交汇地
zh-CN.shortSummary: 敦煌把佛教艺术、文本保存、交通路线和多语文化连接起来。
curatorialDescription: 敦煌提醒我们，长安展厅不能只讲帝国中心。文本、图像和旅行者在边地保存、翻译和重新组织知识，形成另一种文明交汇的空间。
zh-CN.researchNote: 当前为城市与区域级 Alpha 地点，后续补充石窟、藏经洞、路线和跨语言来源。

value.en: Silk Road node and cave-temple region

en.title: Dunhuang
en.subtitle: A religious and textual crossroads on the Silk Road
en.shortSummary: Dunhuang connects Buddhist art, textual preservation, travel routes and multilingual culture.
curatorialDescription: Dunhuang keeps the Chang'an exhibition from becoming a story of an imperial centre alone. Texts, images and travellers preserved, translated and reorganised knowledge at a frontier crossroads.
en.researchNote: This is an Alpha city-and-region place. Caves, the Library Cave, routes and multilingual sources will be added in the next content batch.
